'''''Asphodelus tenuifolius''''' is a species of plant in the asphodel family [[Asphodelaceae]]. It is native to [[North Africa]], [[Southern Europe]], the [[Middle East]] and [[South Asia]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Asphodelus tenuifolius Cav. {{!}} Plants of the World Online {{!}} Kew Science |url=https://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:531576-1 |website=Plants of the World Online |access-date=13 March 2023 |language=en}}</ref> It has been introduced to Australia and the [[Mascarene Islands]]. It is generally present from the Canary Islands, across the Mediterranean to the Middle East and Afghanistan.<ref>{{Cite journal|url=https://www.cabi.org/isc/datasheet/7377|title=Asphodelus tenuifolius (onionweed)|website=www.cabi.org|date=2021 |doi=10.1079/cabicompendium.7377 |access-date=2017-10-29|doi-access=free}}</ref> It has a fibrous root system.
